children: International Stem Cell's revenue fell 11% year over year as lower repeat purchasing across direct-to-consumer, wholesale and reseller channels weighed on skin care sales. Earnings increased, reflecting the LCT sale, which generated a $21.8 million gain.
¹ Reported as “Product sales”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) allocable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Total net income (loss) per common share - basic and diluted”.
: The company completed the sale of LCT to ATCC on September 1, receiving $23.1 million in net cash consideration and recognizing $2.6 million of escrow receivable.
: Product sales declined 11%, driven by lower repeat purchasing across direct-to-consumer, wholesale and reseller channels.
: Profit margin fell 41%; the inventory reserve adjustment shifted from a $13K negative in 2025 to a $21K reserve increase.
: R&D remained focused on Parkinson’s disease, traumatic brain injury and stroke.
